Siri AI is the major upgrade and highlight feature of iOS 27 and later versions. However, only newer Apple devices support the completely revamped Siri. Here is the full hardware list supporting Siri AI, covering iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro.

Here are the Apple products supporting Siri AI on iOS 27 and later

iOS 27 and its related updates include the long-awaited major Siri revamp, named Siri AI.

Siri AI is only available on compatible hardware (and in certain regions). Here are all the Apple products supporting Siri AI.

iPhone

  • iPhone Duo
  • iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone Air
  • iPhone 17
  • iPhone 17e
  • iPhone 16 Pro and Pro Max
  • iPhone 16 and 16 Plus
  • iPhone 16e
  • iPhone 15 Pro and Pro Max

iPad

  • iPad Pro (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad Air (M1 chip and later models)
  • iPad mini (A17 Pro)

Mac

  • All models equipped with Apple silicon (M1 chip and later models, as well as A18 Pro chip)

Apple Watch (needs to be paired with an AI-supported iPhone)

  • Apple Watch Series 9 and later models
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2 and later models
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Apple Vision Pro

  • All models

All the products above support Siri AI. However, certain aspects of the Siri experience will be even better on designated hardware.

For example, the full customisation of Siri AI's voice pacing and expressiveness is only available on designated hardware. According to Apple:

The reason for this limitation is that Apple's most powerful on-device AI model is only available on newer products. Users using these models may experience faster performance with Siri AI, or may not.

Does Siri AI make you want to upgrade to newer Apple hardware? Feel free to let us know in the comments section.
